visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Boyer-Moore Instead of Counting Everything
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every value is counted in an object and then the highest count is searched. Use the Boyer-Moore voting method, which needs no object. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Boyer-Moore uses constant extra memory and one pass. The counting object needs space for every distinct value and a second step to find the largest count.
